issues.description: Wrong screen displayed. The current URL is /design/step-2 but the screenshot shows what appears to be step-1 (room selection). The expected screen is step-3b (style blend confirmation with percentage bars for top styles like 65% Scandinavian, 35% Japandi).
issues.element: Entire page content — showing room picker instead of style blend confirmation
issues.root_cause: The URL is /design/step-2 but the test context says CURRENT SCREEN is step-3b. The console logs show page:mount events for both step-3 and step-3b, suggesting navigation may be working but the screenshot was captured at the wrong step, OR the routing for step-3b is redirecting back to step-2. The page at apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx may be missing or incorrectly redirecting.

issues.description: Hydration errors: aria-label mismatch 'Progress 5 percent' vs 'Progress 15 percent' on step-3, and multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors causing full root re-render to client side.
issues.element: Progress bar aria-label in step-3 page
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, the progress bar percentage is computed differently on server vs client (likely using Math.random(), Date.now(), or reading from localStorage/sessionStorage which is unavailable during SSR). The aria-label renders as '5 percent' on server and '15 percent' on client.

issues.description: Style blend confirmation page (step-3b) is not showing percentage bars with human-readable style names. The console shows page:mount for step-3b fired, but the screenshot shows step-2/room-picker UI.
issues.element: Missing style percentage bars and confirm button on step-3b
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx likely uses COVA* internal keys instead of human-readable names for style display, or the component is not rendering the percentage bars at all.

fixes.reason: Suppresses the hydration mismatch warning for the progress bar aria-label that differs between server and client renders due to dynamic progress calculation.

fixes.new_str:
const styleLabels: Record<string, string> = {
  COVA_SCANDINAVIAN: 'Scandinavian',
  COVA_JAPANDI: 'Japandi',
  COVA_MODERN: 'Modern',
  COVA_BOHEMIAN: 'Bohemian',
  COVA_INDUSTRIAL: 'Industrial',
  COVA_COASTAL: 'Coastal',
  COVA_TRADITIONAL: 'Traditional',
  COVA_MINIMALIST: 'Minimalist',
}
fixes.reason: Maps internal COVA* style keys to human-readable display names so percentage bars show 'Scandinavian' instead of 'COVA_SCANDINAVIAN'.
